item.title: Calls for out-of-hours animal welfare officer
item.dc:creator: Staff Reporter
item.description: Councillors have asked for an animal welfare officer to be on call at night and at weekends after a rise in reports of stray horses on the city’s roads.

item.title: Limerick GAA Sunday Club Results:
item.description: Sunday 1st November. Senior Football Championship Final Fr Casey 0-16 Kildimo/Pallaskenry 2-08. Junior C Football Championship Final Murroe/Boher 1-13 Dromcollogher/Broadford 0-07.

item.title: Ballyagran Club Notes
item.description: Well done to all our teams this week, and thanks to everyone who helped out at the church gate collection on Sunday morning. Training continues on Tuesday nights.

item.title: Win a weekend away for two worth €500
item.description: To be in with a chance of winning a two night stay with dinner on both evenings, simply answer the question below and send your entry before Friday at noon.

item.title: Monthly lotto draw
item.description: There was no winner of this month's jackpot. The numbers drawn were 3, 11, 19 and 24, and the next draw takes place on the first Sunday of December in the clubhouse.

item.title: Library opens new reading room
item.description: The city library has opened a quiet reading room on its second floor, with space for forty people, free wifi and longer opening hours on Thursday evenings.

item.title: Council report from last month
item.description: A report to the council's October meeting set out the progress made on road repairs across the county, with most of the planned work finished ahead of winter.
